stem_book: A ceiling fan having moment of inertia 2 kg-m² attains its maximum frequency of 60 rpm in 2π seconds, with uniform angular acceleration. Calculate its power rating (take the power rating as the power τω delivered at maximum speed).
reason: Coordinator: 'power rating' ambiguous (average vs at max speed) - not used. No printed key entry for Level Board in the answer key; 'power rating' is ambiguous (average power KE/t = 2π W), so the τω-at-maximum-speed interpretation is written into the stem
work: ω = 60 rpm = 2π rad/s; α = 2π/2π = 1 rad/s²; τ = Iα = 2 N m; P = τω = 2·2π = 4π ≈ 12.57 W
